symbols.note: copied from `gatekit symbols system <name> --dll dx11 --full` (addresses are bg3_dx11.exe; the Toolkit's own methods without an address were not found in the game binary and are listed with address null; the per-frame update address is not printed for bg3_dx11.exe by this command, it was found by reading the factory in pseudo-code). Parsed by script from the command output, not retyped.
symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Looks for the existing DataCacheSingleton; when there is none, it creates one new entity and adds three components to it through the deferred buffer: eoc::spell_cast::DataCacheSingletonComponent (0x40 bytes), ls::SavegameComponent (so the cache is saved) and ls::IsGlobalComponent (a 1-byte marker making it a global). When one exists it returns it and flags it dirty for replication.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll (Toolkit build) pseudo-code, DataCacheSystem::GetOrCreateSingleton at +0x11480F0 (125 lines, read whole after filtering asserts). Adds: FUN_181143d00 (+0x1143D00, DAT_18222ad14 -> init +0xDC150 -> 'eoc::spell_cast::DataCacheSingletonComponent', frame storage 0x40); FUN_1802dac40 (+0x2DAC40, the same ls::SavegameComponent helper resolved in the itemwall work, AllocRaw); FUN_1802db590 (+0x2DB590, AllocRaw size 1, DAT_1821f78f4 -> init +0x2D4A0 -> 'ls::IsGlobalComponent'). The condition is the helper FUN_181145ce0 returning an empty result

does.text: Runs a chain: LoadedSession, GatherCreateRequests, GatherDestroyRequests, GatherExternalReferencesRequests, GatherDelayedRemovalRequests, UpdateComponent, UnloadSession, all sharing one Requests object; the gather steps read status apply/remove events and cache create/destroy needs into it, and UpdateComponent applies them to the singleton's cache.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll (Toolkit build) pseudo-code, DataCacheSystem::Update at +0x11495B0 (54 lines, the seven calls read in order). The bodies of the Gather* methods and UpdateComponent were not read, so what they decide is inferred from their names and the view (status ApplyEvent/RemoveEvent one-frame components); treat as a guess from names

does.text: At the end of a session unload it destroys, with the deferred buffer, every entity matched by a query that carries the singleton component (by the view and the method name), i.e. the cache singleton goes with the session.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll (Toolkit build) pseudo-code, DataCacheSystem::UnloadSession at +0x1149430 (115 lines): DestroyEntity loop at about line 104; the guard before it and the query contents were not resolved
